use_cases.name: RFX Request Intake Manager
use_cases.description: Manages the intake process for new RFX (RFP, RFI, RFQ) requests, ensuring all required information is collected and validated.

triggers.name: New RFX Request
triggers.condition: when a new RFX request is created

use_cases.name: RFX Document Generation
use_cases.description: Generates complete RFX documents based on approved requests by retrieving data and creating formatted content.

triggers.name: RFX Request Approved
triggers.condition: when RFX request status changes to approved

use_cases.name: RFX Vendor Q&A Management
use_cases.description: Manages vendor questions during the RFX process, generating professional and consistent responses.

triggers.name: New Vendor Question
triggers.condition: when a new vendor question is submitted

use_cases.name: RFX Vendor Evaluation
use_cases.description: Evaluates vendor proposals against RFX requirements using AI-driven analysis.

triggers.name: Vendor Proposal Received
triggers.condition: when vendor proposal status changes to submitted

use_cases.name: RFX Vendor Finalist Selection
use_cases.description: Compares top-ranked vendor proposals and generates selection recommendations.

triggers.name: Evaluation Complete
triggers.condition: when all vendor evaluations are completed
